primary_question: Do source-resolved non-CM molecular inputs add information about CM development beyond receiver state and anatomy?

feature_sets.A: Capture, size, CM identity, anatomy, broad composition
feature_sets.B: A plus directly measured receiver receptors
feature_sets.D: C plus source-resolved non-CM ligand/matrix-program exposures and source counts

source_families: Col8a1 fibroblasts retained as one family
primary_validation: Held-out contiguous spatial regions; training-only fitting/tuning; explicitly disjoint source neighborhoods where feasible
contact_interpretation: Search range is not verified membrane contact; use separate operational boundary apposition
comparison_learners: Random forest with training-only complexity selection
covariate_gene_overlap: Withhold all outcome genes from predictors and audit compositional normalization
inferred_RNA_activities: Keep distinct from direct Xenium measurements; use withheld-gene/library validation
